paragraphs: We are a leading diversified media company that produces and distributes engaging local and national news, sports and entertainment content across our television and digital platforms, including more than 317,000 hours of programming produced annually by our business units. Nexstar owns America's largest local television broadcasting group comprised of top network affiliates, with over 200 owned or partner stations in 116 U.S. markets in 40 states and the District of Columbia reaching over 225 million people. Nexstar's national television properties include an 80.8% interest in The CW Network, LLC ("The CW"), the fifth major broadcast network in the U.S., NewsNation, a national news network providing "News for All Americans," two popular entertainment multicast networks, Antenna TV and REWIND TV, and a 31.3% ownership stake in Television Food Network, G.P. ("TV Food Network"). The Company's portfolio of digital assets, including its local TV station apps and websites, The Hill and NewsNationNow.com, is collectively a Top 10 U.S. digital news and information property, attracting over 90 million monthly unique users on average during 2025 according to Comscore.

On August 18, 2025, we entered into a definitive Agreement and Plan of Merger (the "Merger Agreement") to acquire the outstanding equity of TEGNA (such transaction, the "Merger"). TEGNA owns and operates 64 television stations and two radio stations in 51 DMAs in the U.S. The Merger is anticipated to close by the second half of 2026. For more information see the "Merger Agreement with TEGNA" paragraph later in this Item 1.

We are a Delaware corporation formed in 1996. Our principal offices are at 545 E. John Carpenter Freeway, Suite 700, Irving, TX 75062. Our telephone number is (972) 373-8800 and our website is http://www.nexstar.tv. The information contained on, or accessible through, our website is not part of this Annual Report on Form 10-K and is not incorporated herein by reference.

Focus on Broadcast Television. The substantial majority of our assets, including our television stations, The CW and our multicast networks, are broadcast television assets. Our television stations are affiliates of CBS, FOX, NBC and ABC (together, the "Big 4"), as well as The CW and MyNetworkTV ("MNTV"). We are the first, second or third largest affiliate group for each broadcast network. According to Nielsen, the Big 4 broadcast networks carry the nation's most-watched programming by a significant margin (including the substantial majority of National Football League ("NFL") games). The broadcast television model has several inherent advantages: (i) it reaches more viewers than any other distribution model, including multichannel and other select pay television subscribers as well as the 18% of the population that only receives their television programming over the air, (ii) it is the preferred distribution platform for most professional sports organizations delivering the widest reach to their fanbases, thereby enhancing franchise value, and (iii) it remains under-monetized as broadcast stations receive a lower percentage of total programming fees paid to content providers by distributors (e.g., cable companies, satellite companies and multichannel streaming platform providers) than the aggregate viewership they generate.

Unique Combination of Scaled Local Audiences and Powerful National Reach. We are the largest local television broadcasting company in the United States, generating $4.9 billion of revenue for the year ended December 31, 2025. Our and our partners' over 200 broadcast stations in 116 local markets reach approximately 70% of U.S. television households (without applying the Federal Communications Commission's ("FCC") ultra-high-frequency ("UHF") discount). This local reach is augmented by the national reach we have via our broadcast network, The CW, and our national news network, NewsNation. According to Nielsen, The CW reaches over 128 million television households, equal to the reach of the ABC, CBS, FOX and NBC broadcast networks, and NewsNation reaches approximately 58 million television households, virtually equivalent to the reach of Fox News, MS NOW and CNN. Together, Nexstar can provide both national reach and activation of local audiences at scale, representing a differentiated and attractive value proposition for advertisers and brands in an increasingly fragmented marketplace.

Leading Local Franchises. We are focused on building and maintaining leading local franchises in the 116 local markets we serve. In total, we employ approximately 6,000 journalists and 1,600 salespeople, produce over 317,000 hours of programming, and have relationships with over 50,000 advertisers. For the year ended December 31, 2025, excluding our owned network assets, the Company earned approximately 68% of its advertising revenue from local (non-network) programming.

• Recognizable Local Brands. Our television stations have typically been established in our markets for decades. Our long-term, track record of reliable local news and community outreach initiatives, provides us with strong local brand recognition and affinity which helps generate viewership and advertising sales.

• High Quality, Independent Local Programming. Our strong local brands are primarily attributable to our high-quality local programming, including news, lifestyle, sports and syndicated programming. All of the news programming produced by Nexstar stations rated by a third-party watchdog group, Ad Fontes, is judged to be politically neutral. In

addition, according to Ad Fontes, virtually all of the news programming has a reliability rating of "reliable; analysis/fact reporting." In 2025, journalists at our stations won 531 awards for their reporting, including 56 Edward R. Murrow awards and 121 Emmy awards.

• Local Sales Force. We employ a local sales force in each of our markets which capitalize on our investment in local programming, websites and connected television ("CTV") or over-the-top ("OTT") applications by selling advertising on these platforms as well as selling third-party digital advertising inventory to enhance advertiser campaigns.

• Presence in Contested Election Markets. In even-numbered years, when most elections are held, we have historically generated substantial revenue from locally driven political advertising. Given our expansive geographic reach, our station footprint typically overlaps with over 80% of contested election markets, enabling us to capture a relatively consistent share of total television broadcasting political advertising spending in election years.

• Duopolies. We own or provide services to more than one station in more than half of our markets which enhances our service to local communities, broadens our audience share, increases our revenue share, and enables significant operating efficiencies.

Strong National Brands. We have a portfolio of scaled, strong national brands that enables us to meaningfully engage with national advertisers. Our primary national brands include The CW, NewsNation and The Hill. The CW is America's fifth national broadcast network. NewsNation is our news network providing fact-based, unbiased "News for All Americans." The Hill is the nation's leading, independent political digital media platform.

Diversified Revenue Streams. Our revenue streams are diversified by geography, affiliation and source. In 2025, we generated 59% of our revenue from distribution, 40% from advertising (approximately 39% from commercial sources and 1% from political sources), and 1% from other sources. No single customer generated more than 13% of our revenue; no single market generated more than 3% of our revenue; and our affiliations are diverse with no network affiliate group representing more than 25% of our 2025 combined core and political advertising net revenue.

headings: Risks Related to the Proposed Merger with TEGNA
The proposed Merger with TEGNA is subject to conditions, some or all of which may not be satisfied, on a timely basis or at all.
Our station revenues and operating results may be adversely affected if we are unable to renew our network affiliation agreements on favorable terms, or at all.

Our revenue and operating results may be adversely affected if we are unable to retain our largest customers, which account for a significant percentage of our total revenue, on favorable terms, or at all.
Our advertising revenue and operating results may be affected by big tech and other media and technology competitors, economic downturns, geopolitical events and other factors outside of our control.
Because a significant percentage of our operating expenses are fixed, a relatively small decrease in revenue could have a significant negative impact on our operating results.
Our growth may be limited if we are unable to implement an acquisition strategy and our operating results may be adversely affected if we are unable to successfully integrate any future acquisition.
Our substantial debt and related interest expense could limit our ability to reinvest in the business, make acquisitions and/or return capital to shareholders.
We may not be able to generate sufficient cash flow to meet our debt service requirements.
We may be required to cease certain station operations if the FCC denies renewal of any of our station licenses.
The loss of the services of our chief executive officer could disrupt management of our business and impair the execution of our business strategies.
Future impairment charges to goodwill and intangible assets could adversely affect our operating results.
Changes in deferred tax assets or valuation allowances as a result of tax law changes could affect our operating results.
We may face additional tax liabilities stemming from proposed and ongoing tax audits.
Our pension and postretirement benefit plan obligations may be increased by a declining stock market and lower interest rates.
Adverse results from litigation or governmental investigations involving us can impact our business practices and operating results.
Any decrease in our dividend payments or suspension of our dividend payments or stock repurchases could cause our stock price to decline.
We may face challenges in protecting our intellectual property (IP) and defending against infringement claims.

We rely on a number of third-party service providers to operate certain significant aspects of our business and any disruption could have an adverse effect on our financial condition and results of operations.
Cybersecurity risks could adversely affect our operating effectiveness and operating results.
Intense competition in the television industry and alternative forms of media could limit our growth and profitability.

New or changed federal statutes, legislation and regulations or changes in the application of existing regulations could significantly impact our operations or the television broadcasting industry as a whole.
We are subject to foreign ownership limitations which limit foreign investments in us.
paragraphs: You should carefully consider the risks described below and all of the information contained in this document. The risks and uncertainties described below are not the only risks and uncertainties that the Company faces. Additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to the Company or that the Company currently deems immaterial may also impair the Company's business operations. If any of those risks occur, the Company's business, financial condition and results of operations could suffer. The risks discussed below also include forward-looking statements, and the Company's actual results may differ substantially from those discussed in these forward-looking statements. See "Cautionary Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements" for further information.

Our business is subject to a number of risks, including risks that may prevent us from achieving our business objectives or may adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, cash flows, and prospects. These risks are discussed more fully below and include, but are not limited to:
• The proposed Merger with TEGNA is subject to conditions, some or all of which may not be satisfied, on a timely basis or at all; and

• We may fail to realize all of the anticipated benefits of the Merger with TEGNA, or those benefits may take longer to realize than expected. The combined company may also encounter difficulties in integrating the two businesses.

• Our distribution revenues and operating results may be adversely affected by, among other factors, declining MVPD subscribers, our inability to renew expiring distribution agreements on favorable terms, or at all, and our network partners inability to renew expiring distribution agreements on favorable terms with vMPVDs, or at all;
• Our station revenues and operating results may be adversely affected if we are unable to renew our network affiliation agreements on favorable terms, or at all;

paragraphs: • Entered into a definitive agreement to acquire TEGNA Inc. for $6.2 billion in a transaction expected to be accretive to Nexstar's standalone Adjusted Free Cash Flow. The transaction is subject to regulatory approvals and is anticipated to close by the second half of 2026.
• Returned approximately $351 million of capital to shareholders through repurchases of common stock and dividends.
• Renewed distribution agreements in the fourth quarter, covering more than 60% of our subscriber base.

• Acquired the assets of WBNX-TV, an independent full power television station serving the Cleveland, OH market for a $22 million cash purchase price. On September 1, 2025, the station became affiliated with The CW.

• Completed the refinancing of senior secured credit facilities on June 27, 2025, reducing the interest margin, increasing capacity under our revolver, and extending the maturities. During 2025, the Company repaid $185 million of its debt.

As of February 26, 2026, we owned, operated, programmed or provided sales and other services to 201 full power television stations and one AM radio station, including those owned by VIEs, in 116 markets in 40 states and the District of Columbia. The stations are affiliates of ABC, NBC, FOX, CBS, The CW, MNTV and other broadcast television networks.

Through various local service agreements, we provided sales, programming and other services to 37 full power television stations owned by independent third parties, of which 35 full power television stations are VIEs that are consolidated into our financial statements. See Note 2 to our Consolidated Financial Statements included in Part IV, Item 15(a) of this Annual Report on Form 10-K for a discussion of the local service agreements we have with these independent third parties. We do not own the consolidated VIEs or their television stations. However, we are deemed under U.S. GAAP to have controlling financial interests for financial reporting purposes in these entities because of (i) the local service agreements we have with their stations, (ii) our (excluding The CW) guarantee of the obligations incurred under Mission's senior secured credit facility, (iii) our power over significant activities affecting the consolidated VIEs' economic performance, including budgeting for advertising revenue, advertising sales and, in some cases, hiring and firing of sales force personnel and (iv) purchase options granted by each consolidated VIE which permit us to acquire the assets and assume the liabilities of each of these VIEs' stations, subject to FCC consent. In compliance with FCC regulations for all the parties, each of the consolidated VIEs maintains complete responsibility for and control over programming, finances and personnel for its stations.

As of December 31, 2025, we also own an 80.8% ownership interest in The CW, the fifth major broadcast network in the U.S., NewsNation, a national news network, two multicast networks, Antenna TV and REWIND TV, multicast network services provided to third parties, and a 31.3% ownership stake in TV Food Network. Our digital assets include 125 local websites and 229 mobile applications across local stations, NewsNation and The Hill. The portfolio also includes 110 CTV applications and three FAST channels from The CW and The Hill.

The Company generates revenue primarily from distribution and advertising. Distribution revenue consists of fees received for the retransmission of our stations' signals and for the carriage of our cable and broadcast networks by cable, satellite, and other MVPDs, vMVPDs, and direct-to-consumer OTT services. Advertising revenue is derived from the sale of local and national advertising across our stations, networks, websites, apps, and other digital platforms, including through third‑party media partners. In even-numbered years, we also earn significant political advertising revenue from candidates, political action committees, political parties, and interest groups.
Our principal operating expenses include third-party programming, news production, promotion, sales, digital cost of goods sold, content creation, and other administrative and corporate costs.
For additional information, see Item 1. "Business" and Item 1A. "Risk Factors."

paragraphs: 本公司為一家領導的多元化媒體公司，透過電視與數位平台，製造與發行吸引人的本地與全國新聞、體育與娛樂內容，包括每年由各業務單位製造超過 317,000 小時的節目。Nexstar 擁有美國規模最大的本地電視廣播集團，包含頂級聯播網特許經營權，擁有或合作的電臺站數超過 200 個，分佈於美國 40 個州與華盛頓特區的 116 個市場，覆蓋人口超過 225 百萬人。Nexstar 的全國性電視資產包括對 The CW Network, LLC（"The CW"）80.8% 的權益，為美國第五大廣播網；NewsNation，為提供 "News for All Americans" 的全國新聞網；兩個受歡迎的娛樂多頻道網路 Antenna TV 與 REWIND TV；以及對 Television Food Network, G.P.（"TV Food Network"）31.3% 的股權。本公司數位資產組合，包括本地電視電臺應用程式與網站、The Hill 與 NewsNationNow.com， collectively 為美國前十大數位新聞與資訊平台，根據 Comscore 資料，2025 年平均每月獨特使用者超過 90 百萬人。
於 2025 年 8 月 18 日，本公司與 TEGNA 簽訂了最終版的合併協議（"Merger Agreement"），以收購 TEGNA 的所有股權（此交易稱為 "Merger"）。TEGNA 在美國 51 個 DMA 中擁有並營運 64 個電視電臺與兩個電臺。此合併預計於 2026 年第二季完成。更多資訊請參閱本項目後續的 "與 TEGNA 的合併協議" 段落。
本公司為 1996 年成立於特拉華州的公司。本公司總部位於 545 E. John Carpenter Freeway, Suite 700, Irving, TX 75062。本公司電話為 (972) 373-8800，網站為 http://www.nexstar.tv。網站上或可存取的資訊並非本 10-K 年度報告的一部分，亦未經引用納入 herein。

聚焦於廣播電視。本公司資產的絕大多數，包括電視電臺、The CW 與多頻道電臺網，為廣播電視資產。本公司電視電臺為 CBS、FOX、NBC 與 ABC（合稱 "Big 4"）以及 The CW 與 MyNetworkTV（"MNTV"）的聯播網。本公司為每家廣播電視網的第一、第二或第三大聯播網。根據尼爾森資料，Big 4 廣播電視網擁有美國觀眾最多的節目（包括大多數國家美式足球聯盟（"NFL"）賽事）。廣播電視模式有幾個內在優勢：(i) 它能接觸到比其他分發模式（包括多頻道及其他選擇性付費電視訂閱者）更多的觀眾，以及 18% 的人口僅透過空氣接收電視節目；(ii) 它是大多數專業體育組織的首選分發平台，能提供最廣的觀眾覆蓋，進而提升球隊價值；(iii) 廣播電視臺仍處於未充分商業化狀態，因廣播電視臺從內容供應商收取的總節目費用比例較低，而其觀眾數量卻相當高（例如：有線電視公司、衛星電視公司與多頻道串流平台供應商）。

獨特的本地觀眾規模與強大全國覆蓋力組合。本公司為美國最大的本地電視廣播公司，2025 年度營業收入為 4.9 十億美元。本公司與合作夥伴在 116 個本地市場擁有超過 200 個廣播電臺站，覆蓋約 70% 的美國電視家庭（未應用聯邦通訊委員會（"FCC"）超高頻（"UHF"）折扣）。此本地覆蓋力透過我們的廣播網 The CW 與全國新聞網 NewsNation 的全國覆蓋力加以強化。根據 Nielsen 資料，The CW 覆蓋超過 128 百萬個電視家庭，與 ABC、CBS、FOX 與 NBC 廣播網的覆蓋力相當；NewsNation 覆蓋約 58 百萬個電視家庭，幾乎與 Fox News、MS NOW 與 CNN 的覆蓋力相當。透過 Nexstar，我們可同時提供全國覆蓋力與大規模本地觀眾的活化，代表在日益分散的市場中，對廣告客戶與品牌而言，為一差異化且具吸引力的價值主張。
領導的本地品牌。我們專注於在服務的 116 個本地市場中建立與維持領導的本地品牌。總計，我們僱用約 6,000 名記者與 1,600 名銷售人員，製造超過 317,000 小時的節目，並與超過 50,000 家廣告商有關係。2025 年 12 月 31 日為止（扣除本公司所擁有的網路資產），本公司約 68% 的廣告收入來自本地（非網路）節目。
• 可辨識的本地品牌。本公司電視電臺在所服務的市場中通常已建立數十年。我們長期可靠的本地新聞與社區推廣活動，使我們擁有強大的本地品牌認知與親近感，有助於產生觀眾與廣告銷售。
• 高品質、獨立的本地節目。我們強大的本地品牌主要歸功於我們高品質的本地節目，包括新聞、生活、體育與 syndicated 節目。所有 Nexstar 電臺所製造的節目，經第三方監測機構 Ad Fontes 評估，均被認為政治中立。
此外，根據 Ad Fontes，幾乎所有新聞節目都有「可靠；分析/事實報導」的可信度評分。在 2025 年，我們的電臺記者因報導獲得了 531 項獎項，包括 56 項 Edward R. Murrow 獎與 121 項艾美獎。
• 本地銷售團隊。我們在每個電臺市場都僱用本地銷售團隊，透過我們在本地節目、網站及串流電視（"CTV"）或串流（"OTT"）應用的投資，透過這些平台銷售廣告，同時銷售第三方數位廣告存貨以強化廣告主的行銷活動。
• 參與爭議性選舉市場。在偶數年，當大多數選舉舉行時，我們歷來從本地驅動的政治廣告中產生大量收入。根據我們廣泛的地理覆蓋範圍，我們的電臺覆蓋範圍通常與超過 80% 的爭議性選舉市場重疊，使我們能夠在選舉年間穩定取得電視廣播政治廣告支出的相對固定份額。
• 雙臺經營。我們在超過一半的市場擁有或提供服務給多個電臺，這有助於我們為當地社區提供更好的服務，擴大觀眾佔有率，提高收入佔有率，並實現顯著的運營效率。
強大的國家品牌。我們擁有規模化且強大的國家品牌組合，使我們能與國家廣告主進行有意義的互動。我們的主要國家品牌包括 The CW、NewsNation 和 The Hill。The CW 是美國第五大國家廣播網路。NewsNation 是我們的新聞網路，提供基於事實、無偏見的 "所有美國人都適用的新聞"。The Hill 是美國首屈一指的獨立政治數位媒體平台。

多元化的收入來源。我們的收入來源根據地理區域、合作關係及來源進行多元化。在 2025 年，我們有 59% 的收入來自分發，40% 來自廣告（約 39% 來自商業來源及 1% 來自政治來源），以及 1% 來自其他來源。沒有單一客戶產生超過 13% 的收入；沒有單一市場產生超過 3% 的收入；我們的合作關係也相當多元，沒有任何網路合作夥伴組合代表超過 25% 的 2025 年合併核心及政治廣告淨收入。

paragraphs: • 與TEGNA Inc.簽訂最終協議，以62億美元收購該公司，預期將對Nexstar的獨立調整現金流量產生正面影響。此交易需經監管機關核准，預計於2026年下半年完成。
• 透過股票回購與股息，將約3.51億美元資本回饋給股東。
• 在第四季更新分銷協議，涵蓋超過60%的訂戶基礎。
• 收購WBNX-TV的資產，該為獨立全權電視臺，服務俄亥俄州克里夫蘭地區，以現金2200萬美元購入。2025年9月1日，該電臺成為The CW的成員。
• 完成於 2025 年 6 月 27 日的高階抵押信貸設施重組，降低利息邊際，增加我們的循環信貸額度，並延長到期日。於 2025 年，本公司償還 185 百萬美元的債務。
2026年2月26日，本公司擁有、營運、編製節目或提供銷售及其他服務的全權電視臺共201座，以及1座AM電臺，包括VIEs所擁有的電臺，分佈於40個州及華盛頓特區的116個市場。這些電臺為ABC、NBC、FOX、CBS、The CW、MNTV及其他廣播電視網的成員。

透過各種地方服務協議，本公司為37座獨立第三方所擁有的全權電視臺提供銷售、編製節目及其他服務，其中35座為VIEs，已納入本公司財務報表。請參閱本年度10-K表報表第IV項第15(a)款所附的合併財務報表附註2，以瞭解本公司與這些獨立第三方所訂立的地方服務協議。本公司不擁有這些合併VIEs或其電視臺。然而，根據美國會計準則，本公司因以下原因被視為對這些實體具有控制性財務權益（為財務報導目的）：(i) 我們與其電臺所訂立的地方服務協議；(ii) 我們（不包括The CW）擔保Mission所負的高階抵押信貸設施義務；(iii) 我們對影響合併VIEs經濟表現的重大活動具有控制權，包括廣告收入預算、廣告銷售，以及在某些情況下銷售團隊的聘僱與解僱；(iv) 每個合併VIE所提供的購買選擇權，使我們可取得這些VIEs電臺的資產並承擔其負債，但需經FCC核准。為符合所有參與方的FCC規範，每個合併VIE均對其電臺的節目、財務及人事擁有完全責任與控制權。

截至2025年12月31日，本公司亦擁有The CW 80.8%的股權，為美國第五大廣播電視網；擁有NewsNation，為全國新聞網；兩座多頻道網路；Antenna TV及REWIND TV，為提供給第三方的多頻道網路服務；以及TV Food Network 31.3%的股權。我們的數位資產包括125個地方網站及229個移動應用程式，遍及地方電臺、NewsNation及The Hill。此組合亦包含110個CTV應用程式及The CW與The Hill的三個FAST頻道。
本公司主要透過分銷與廣告產生營業收入。分銷收入包含因重新傳輸我們電臺訊號而收取的費用，以及電纜、衛星及其他MVPDs、vMVPDs與直接對消費者OTT服務電臺與廣播網路的傳輸費用。廣告收入來自於我們電臺、網路、網站、APP及其他數位平台所銷售的本地與全國性廣告，包括透過第三方媒體夥伴進行的銷售。在偶數年，我們也會從候選人、政治行動委員會、政黨及利益團體獲得顯著的政治廣告收入。
我們的主要營運費用包括第三方節目、新聞製作、推廣、銷售、數位成本商品銷售、內容製作及其他行政與企業費用。
如需更多資訊，請參閱第1項「業務」及第1A項「風險因素」。

headings: 與與TEGNA擬議合併相關的風險
與我們營運相關的風險
與我們產業相關的風險
與TEGNA擬議合併相關的條件，部分或全部可能無法如期或完全達成。
若我們無法以有利條件續約網路合作協議，或完全無法續約，可能會對我們的電臺收入及營運結果產生不利影響。
若我們無法以有利條件留住我們最大的客戶，這些客戶佔我們總收入的顯著比例，可能會對我們的收入及營運結果產生不利影響。
我們的廣告收入及營運結果可能受大科技公司及其他媒體與科技競爭者、經濟衰退、地緣政治事件及其他超出我們控制範圍的因素影響。
因為我們的營運費用有相當大比例為固定費用，營業收入相對小幅減少，可能對營運結果產生顯著負面影響。
若我們無法實施收購策略，成長可能受到限制，且若無法成功整合未來的收購，營運結果可能受到不利影響。
我們的高額債務及相關利息支出，可能限制我們對業務的再投資、進行收購及/或回饋資本給股東的能力。
我們可能無法產生足夠的現金流量以償還債務支出。
若FCC拒絕續發我們任何電臺執照，我們可能被迫停止某些電臺運營。
我們首席執行官的離職可能幹擾業務管理，並影響我們業務策略的執行。
未來對商譽及無形資產的減損費用，可能對營運結果產生不利影響。
因稅法變更而導致遞延稅資產或評價允許金額的變動，可能影響營運結果。
我們可能因擬議中及進行中的稅務稽查而面臨額外的稅務負擔。
我們的退休金及退休後福利計畫義務可能因股市下跌及利率降低而增加。
我們涉及的訴訟或政府調查不利結果可能影響我們的業務作法及營運成果。
我們股息支付減少或暫停股息支付或股票回購，可能導致我們股票價格下跌。
我們可能面臨保護智慧財產權（IP）及防禦侵權聲請的挑戰。
我們依賴多家第三方服務供應商運作我們業務的重要方面，任何中斷都可能對我們的財務狀況及營運成果產生不利影響。
網路安全風險可能對我們的營運效能及營運成果產生不利影響。
電視產業及替代性媒體形式的激烈競爭可能限制我們的成長與獲利能力。
新或修改的聯邦法規、立法及規章，或現有規章之適用方式變更，可能對本公司營運或電視廣播產業整體產生重大影響。
本公司受外資擁有權限制之規範，此限制可能影響外資對本公司的投資。
paragraphs: 您應仔細審閱下列所列風險，以及本文件中所載之所有資訊。下列所列風險與不確定性並非本公司所面臨之唯一風險與不確定性。尚有其他風險與不確定性，目前本公司尚未知悉，或目前認為不重要，也可能影響本公司之業務運作。若任何上述風險發生，將可能使本公司之業務、財務狀況與營運結果遭受影響。下列所討論之風險亦包含前瞻性陳述，本公司實際結果可能與這些前瞻性陳述中所討論者有顯著差異。請參閱「關於前瞻性陳述之警示」以取得更多資訊。
本公司業務面臨許多風險，包括可能使本公司無法達成業務目標，或對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運結果、現金流與前景造成不利影響之風險。這些風險在下文中將更詳細說明，包括但不限於：
• 與TEGNA之擬議合併案受條件限制，部分或全部條件可能無法於合適時間內或根本無法達成；
• 本公司可能無法實現與TEGNA合併案預期之所有好處，或這些好處可能比預期花費更長時間才能實現。合併後之公司也可能在整合兩家公司業務時遇到困難。
• 我們之分銷收入與營運結果可能因多種因素而受到不利影響，包括MVPD訂戶數下降、本公司無法以有利條件續約到期之分銷協議，或根本無法續約，以及我們之網路夥伴無法以有利條件續約到期之分銷協議，或根本無法續約；
• 若我們無法以有利條件續約我們之網路聯盟協議，或根本無法續約，則我們之電臺收入與營運結果可能受到不利影響；
